note:
Roadside dispersed sites along Slippery Brook in the White Mountain National Forest; most are directly on the river and some will accomodate small RVs.  --AWH.
Since June 2026 a Forest Order (R9-22-05-26-04, to June 2031) allows camping within a quarter mile of Slippery Brook Road (FR 17) and East Branch Road (FR 38) only at designated sites marked by a post with a tent symbol, and wood or charcoal fires only at those sites. The roads are gated in winter (they opened May 11 in 2026). --Claude
summary: Stored website is The Dyrt (aggregator). The WMNF camping page lists 'Town Hall Road - 24 sites' as designated first-come roadside camping, and a June 2026 Forest Order limits camping and fires near FR 17/FR 38 to posted designated sites. sites.count 24 and first-come booking confirmed; --AWH creekside left as is; roads open since 05/11/2026.

FIT/ACCESS: the FS states no rig length and no 4WD/high-clearance wording for Town Hall Road. Fit rests on --AWH ('some will accomodate small RVs') and the stored inclusion evidence. Designated posted sites may be smaller than the former dispersed pull-offs; a 23-ft fit at the new posted sites is unverified.

WATERFRONT: --AWH creekside left unchanged. The pin sits under full canopy between FR 17 (Slippery Brook) and FR 38 (East Branch) just above their junction; Esri leaf-on imagery shows only the gravel roads, so neither the brook channels nor the posted sites can be checked from imagery. No disagreement to report.
PIN 44.1613,-71.0950 is about 50-80 m off either road near the FR 17/FR 38 split; the FS publishes no per-site positions, so no move proposed.
